description:
Trinket! is a turn-based card RPG where your Hero and Companion share one hand of cards. Combine their abilities, equip earned loot, unlock talents, and build a party that fits your strategy.

Explore seven Campaign chapters, climb seven Spires, venture deeper into the endless Labyrinth, take on Contracts with rewards shown up front, and embark on regional Voyages. Each of the seven bosses features an original vocal theme with live lyrics in combat. Between adventures, build your Homestead to grow herbs, forge gear, and strengthen your roster.

FREE TO START

Try all five modes for free, with no ads, no subscriptions, and no energy timers. Play the first three Campaign chapters, the first three Labyrinth floors, and the first ten floors of every Spire. Contracts are unlimited, and Voyage includes Goldpine Forest, The Underkeep, and Ember Dunes adventures. Equipment, Homestead, and the ability and talent progression of accessible characters are available in free play.

ONE FULL GAME PURCHASE

A permanent, one-time Full Game purchase (with Family Sharing) unlocks the remaining chapters, deeper Spire and Labyrinth floors, and the full roster of Heroes and Companions. Characters, equipment, and upgrades are still earned through play. Future content released within Trinket is included; there is no promised update schedule.

PLAY WITHOUT AN ACCOUNT

No Trinket account is required. Play offline. Progress syncs automatically between devices signed into the same iCloud account; without iCloud, progress stays on your device.
